label: I-067-prewarm-v14-fdda
notes: ATTENDED RUN. CAPTURE COUNT: repeats 3 x 2 arms = 6 captures, the user at the keyboard for all six (~2 min of play each). Baseline = agent-I063-b (agent-I057-b + alao-prewarm v1.3). Variant = agent-I067-b (agent-I057-b + alao-prewarm v1.4). The arms differ by exactly one added file, gamedata/scripts/zzz_alao_prewarm_fdda.script, plus the version string in zzz_alao_prewarm.script (1.3 -> 1.4, no code change). Nothing is replaced, no function is patched. Profiler overlay used as-is, do NOT rebuild it. WHAT v1.4 DOES: at actor_on_first_update (frame ~7, loading screen up) it warms, for FDDA Redone's backpack open/idle/close animation and for every FDDA-animated item in the ruck, the four things liz_fdda_redone_consumables' enter() loads cold on the frame of first use: the hud motion container (game.get_motion_length, a query), the item model (game.motion_exists = the same model_Create under hud_loading, handed back to the model pool), the sound (sound_object held, never played) and the cam .anm file (read into the OS cache). No hud motion is started, no cam effector added, no sound played. WHAT THE TARGET ROW IS: actor_on_update#lam2.script:271. In all 12 earlier I-062/I-063 captures it has ONE call of 9.0-11.6 ms about 1 s after the FIRST inventory open - that is FDDA's backpack_open animation, not an item - and, only when the player used a consumable, a second one of 13.5 / 25.6 / 30.4 ms. Later calls are 0.4-0.8 ms. The frm lines show these frames are script (14 ms frame / 9.8 script; 35 / 30.7), so here listener ms ~= frame ms. SCRIPTED ROUTINE, identical in all six captures: (1) touch NOTHING until the 30 s warm-up is over - no inventory, no item, no quick-use key before the capture starts; (2) at about 0:40 open the inventory (I) and LEAVE IT OPEN for ~4 s so the backpack animation plays (it starts ~1 s after the open); (3) with the inventory still open, use ONE animated consumable from the ruck by double-click - the SAME item in every capture. I could not read the save's ruck offline: the variant's engine log names the candidates in the line '[alao_prewarm]   fdda items: ...' at load, so take the FIRST name on that line (from variant capture 1, or from any earlier v1.4 load) and use that item in all six; if the list is empty the save has no animated consumable and part A2 cannot be run - say so; (4) let the use animation finish (~5-15 s), close the inventory, wait ~5 s; (5) open the inventory ONCE more, wait ~4 s, close it (this gives the warm reference calls); (6) stand still and stop ~30 s before the end. Do not pick anything up, do not loot, do not go near a campfire. This is a HITCH comparison: the player drives the workload by hand, so mean script ms/frame and fps deltas between the arms mean nothing and must not be quoted. Read it back with: py -3.12 lab/tools/profile_report.py --queue <id> --frames --axes --trace --hitch --listeners --top 400, and grep each run's xray.log for 'lam2.script:271' (hit lines: max, first_units, b= buckets) and for '[alao_prewarm'.

pass_conditions.row: lst actor_on_update#lam2.script:271 - A1, the backpack animation, first call over the floor (hit line: first_units / first_frame)
pass_conditions.baseline: 9.0-11.6 ms in 12 of 12 earlier captures, ~1 s after the first inventory open; expect the same in all 3 baseline captures
pass_conditions.variant_expected: the first over-floor call drops to the warm level, 0.4-1.6 ms, and the 6.4-12.8 bucket of the b= histogram stays EMPTY until the item use
pass_conditions.passes_if: in all 3 variant captures the lam2.script:271 call ~1 s after the first open is >= 5 ms below the baseline's (i.e. <= ~5 ms against ~10), AND the frame containing it (frm line, if it still crosses the 12 ms slow-frame floor at all) is >= 5 ms shorter. Baseline spread across 12 captures is 9.0-11.6, so 3 v 3 resolves a 5 ms move cleanly.
pass_conditions.fails_if: the variant still shows a 6.4-12.8 ms call there. Then read the log: 'fdda models: 0 loaded' or 'N missing' means the model step did not run; if everything reports loaded and the call is still ~10 ms, the cost is in the part named as engine (hud blend start / first draw) and A1 closes as engine.

pass_conditions.row: lst actor_on_update#lam2.script:271 - A2, the first consumable (hit line: max, and the frm line of that frame)
pass_conditions.baseline: 13.5 / 25.6 / 30.4 ms in the three earlier captures that used an item; up to 54 ms on the first launch of a sitting (OS file cache cold)
pass_conditions.variant_expected: warm level for a consumable enter, which earlier captures put at 3.2-6.4 ms (it includes alife_create_item and FDDA's own work, which this mod does not touch)
pass_conditions.passes_if: variant max over the item-use call is >= 5 ms below the baseline's in the capture-by-capture pairing (1v2, 3v4, 5v6), same item in both arms
pass_conditions.fails_if: no difference: then either the item used is not on the 'fdda items:' line (it was not in the ruck at load - check), or the consumable cost is FDDA's script work rather than cold resources.
pass_conditions.note: Capture 1 is the first launch of the sitting for the baseline and capture 2 for the variant, so the OS-cache-cold outlier, if any, lands on the BASELINE. Do not credit the mod with that; judge A2 on captures 3-6.

pass_conditions.variant_expected: '[alao_prewarm 1.4] done' block unchanged from v1.3 otherwise, then '[alao_prewarm 1.4] fdda', 'fdda: 3 backpack sections (faction <f>) + N animated item sections out of M items in the ruck, K steps', 'fdda items: ...', 'fdda motions: a hud sections warmed, 0 missing, 0 failed, X ms', 'fdda models: a loaded, 0 missing, 0 failed, X ms', 'fdda sounds: a built, 0 failed, X ms (held, never played)', 'fdda cam files: a read, b not loose, 0 failed, X ms', 'fdda: X ms total, synchronous at first update', 'fdda on-take: armed, 1 step(s) per frame'
pass_conditions.passes_if: models loaded >= 2 (the two backpack visuals) and motions warmed >= 2, zero 'failed' anywhere
pass_conditions.fails_if: 'not installed, nothing to do' (script namespaces not reachable at first update), 'models: 0 loaded, N missing' (game.motion_exists or getFS():exist not behaving as read from the source), or any '! ' engine error line right after the fdda block.
pass_conditions.note: The 'fdda models: ... X ms' number is itself the measurement of the model share of the split, which the profiler cannot give: what it reads at load is what left the first-use frame.

pass_conditions.row: what the player could notice (ask, blind to the arm order)

pass_conditions.fails_if: anything visible or audible at load, or a wrong-looking item model / texture in the first animation (that would mean a model loaded outside the real hud path differs - turn FDDA_MODELS off and rerun).
